subject.title: feat: heading-aware chunking + entity extraction for memory search

question: Should maintainers approve heading-aware memory chunking as a narrow memory-core deliverable now, and should it be default markdown behavior or an opt-in strategy?
rationale: The source-visible chunking gap is concrete, but the requested entity extraction and graph-memory scope plus prior config-heavy PRs require product/API direction before automation should implement it.

options.title: Approve Narrow Chunking First
options.body: Implement heading-aware splitting for markdown memory chunks with oversized-section fallback and index revalidation, leaving entity extraction for the Memory MVP issues.

options.title: Require Opt-In Strategy Design
options.body: Keep current fixed-size behavior as default and ask for a maintainer-approved chunking strategy/config design before any implementation PR.

options.title: Defer To Memory MVP
options.body: Do not split this issue; wait until the broader Memory MVP schema, entity, and wiki synthesis direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Chunking First
recommendation.body: Implement heading-aware splitting for markdown memory chunks with oversized-section fallback and index revalidation, leaving entity extraction for the Memory MVP issues.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent history put this account closest to the active memory-core chunking and config surfaces.
